description: This Java enum defines various metric types used within the Eclipse Ditto connectivity module, including their names and supported directions.

classes.name: MetricType
classes.description: Defines known metric types with associated names and valid directions, providing methods to retrieve metrics by name, check supported directions, and obtain string representations.

methods.name: MetricType.getName
methods.description: Returns the JSON-compatible label for the metric type.

methods.name: MetricType.supportsDirection
methods.description: Determines if a given MetricDirection is supported by this MetricType.

methods.name: MetricType.forName
methods.description: Retrieves an Optional containing the MetricType matching the provided name.

methods.name: MetricType.toString
methods.description: Returns the name of the MetricType as its string representation.
